svg.title: A wedding with drums
svg.desc: Paper-cut scene in golden light: in front of a big house on stilts with a saddle-shaped thatched roof, Lạc Long Quân and Âu Cơ hold hands and smile at their wedding. On the left, a man beats a bronze drum with a star on top and another plays a bamboo mouth organ. On the right, a woman and a child cheer with their arms up, and another woman smiles.
